# ui::RenderRecording

Header: `winui/render/RenderRecording.hpp`.

Derives from `ui::Renderer`.

A [Renderer](renderer.md) that keeps every call, with its full arguments, so it can be replayed into any other [Renderer](renderer.md) later, any number of times: a resolution-independent snapshot of an element.

Unlike TestRenderer, which records commands as data for tests (without a bitmap's pixels or an SVG's markup), this copies whatever each call needs to be drawn again. It is what a [ConnectedAnimation](../tree/connected-animation.md#uiconnectedanimation) shows of its source after the source itself is gone.

Example: 
```cpp
ui::Control<ui::Border> card; // filled through the card's `.control`
const float             fade = 0.6f;

// Take a snapshot of a card before it leaves the tree.
ui::RenderRecording snapshot;
card->render(snapshot);

// Later, in a custom control's render_override(), once per frame while the snapshot flies to
// its destination. The same recording replays as often as needed.
if (!snapshot.empty())
{
    renderer.push_opacity_layer(fade);
    renderer.push_transform(0.8f, ui::Point{40, 20});
    snapshot.replay(renderer);
    renderer.pop_transform();
    renderer.pop_opacity_layer();
}
```

## fill_rounded_rect

```cpp
void fill_rounded_rect(const Rect& bounds, float radius, const Color& color) override
```

Fills a rect with rounded corners (`radius` in DIPs, 0 for square) in a solid color.

## stroke_rounded_rect

```cpp
void stroke_rounded_rect(const Rect& bounds, float radius, const Color& color, float stroke_width) override
```

Strokes a rounded rect's outline, the pen centered on `bounds`' edge.

## draw_text

```cpp
void draw_text(std::string_view text, const Rect& bounds, const Color& color, const TextStyle& style) override
```

Draws UTF-8 `text` laid out in `bounds` per `style` (font, alignment, wrapping). [Text](../controls/text.md#uitext) overflowing `bounds` is not trimmed, and not clipped unless a clip is pushed.

## fill_rounded_rect_gradient

```cpp
void fill_rounded_rect_gradient(const Rect& bounds, float radius, const LinearGradientBrush& brush) override
```

Fills a rounded rect with a gradient along the brush's axis. The XP and Vista themes draw their chrome with it.

## stroke_rounded_rect_gradient

```cpp
void stroke_rounded_rect_gradient(const Rect& bounds, float radius, const LinearGradientBrush& brush, float extent_px, float stroke_width) override
```

Strokes a rounded rect with a gradient spanning `extent_px` device pixels, for Fluent's elevation border. [StrokeRoundedRectGradient](render-commands.md#struct-strokeroundedrectgradient) explains the sign of `extent_px`.

## stroke_line

```cpp
void stroke_line(Point from, Point to, const Color& color, float stroke_width) override
```

A straight line; also one edge of a classic raised/sunken bevel (see [draw_bevel_border()](namespace-ui.md#draw_bevel_border), which draws a whole border out of these).

## stroke_wavy_line

```cpp
void stroke_wavy_line(Point from, Point to, const Color& color, float stroke_width, float amplitude, float wavelength) override
```

Draws the misspelling squiggle (see [StrokeWavyLine](render-commands.md#struct-strokewavyline)).

## fill_polygon

```cpp
void fill_polygon(const FillPolygon& polygon) override
```

Fills a closed polygon with one color (see [FillPolygon](render-commands.md#struct-fillpolygon)).

## stroke_polyline

```cpp
void stroke_polyline(const StrokePolyline& polyline) override
```

Strokes straight lines through a list of points (see [StrokePolyline](render-commands.md#struct-strokepolyline)).

## draw_geometry

```cpp
void draw_geometry(const DrawGeometry& geometry) override
```

Fills and strokes a [PathGeometry](path-geometry.md) (see [DrawGeometry](render-commands.md#struct-drawgeometry)). A backend that cannot draw an [AcrylicBrush](acrylic-brush.md) draws its fallback color.

## push_clip

```cpp
void push_clip(const Rect& bounds) override
```

Clips everything drawn until the matching [pop_clip()](#pop_clip) to `bounds`, intersected with any enclosing clip.

## pop_clip

```cpp
void pop_clip() override
```

Ends the innermost [push_clip()](#push_clip), [push_clip_ellipse()](#push_clip_ellipse) or [push_clip_rounded_rect()](#push_clip_rounded_rect).

## push_clip_ellipse

```cpp
void push_clip_ellipse(Point center, float radius_x, float radius_y) override
```

An elliptical clip, ended by the same [pop_clip()](#pop_clip) as a rect clip (see [PushClipEllipse](render-commands.md#struct-pushclipellipse)).

## push_clip_rounded_rect

```cpp
void push_clip_rounded_rect(const Rect& bounds, float radius) override
```

A clip to `bounds` with corners rounded by `radius`, ended by the same [pop_clip()](#pop_clip) (see [PushClipRoundedRect](push-clip-rounded-rect.md)). A radius of 0 is the same clip as [push_clip()](#push_clip).

## fill_ellipse

```cpp
void fill_ellipse(Point center, float radius_x, float radius_y, const Color& color) override
```

Fills an ellipse centered on `center`, radii in DIPs.

## stroke_ellipse

```cpp
void stroke_ellipse(Point center, float radius_x, float radius_y, const Color& color, float stroke_width) override
```

Strokes an ellipse outline centered on `center`, radii in DIPs.

## fill_rect_pattern

```cpp
void fill_rect_pattern(const Rect& bounds, Pattern pattern, const Color& fg, const Color& bg) override
```

Fills `bounds` with a two-color stipple (see [Pattern](namespace-ui.md#pattern)).

## draw_image_nine_slice

```cpp
void draw_image_nine_slice(const std::string& image_name, const Rect& bounds, const Thickness& slice_margins) override
```

Optional image-theme chrome (see ImageThemePack). A no-op wherever `image_name` isn't found in whatever pack the backend was configured with; ImageThemePack::empty() is the common case, and every backend must tolerate it. The default draws nothing, which is what a backend with no pack does.

## draw_image

```cpp
void draw_image(const Bitmap& image, const Rect& bounds, Stretch stretch) override
```

A caller-supplied bitmap, stretched into `bounds` per `stretch` (see [DrawImage](render-commands.md#struct-drawimage)). `image` need only be valid for the duration of the call.

## draw_image_rect

```cpp
void draw_image_rect(const Bitmap& image, const Rect& source, const Rect& bounds) override
```

Draws the `source` part of `image` into `bounds` (see [DrawImageRect](render-commands.md#struct-drawimagerect)). `source` is in the image's pixels and is clipped to them.

## draw_svg

```cpp
void draw_svg(const SvgImage& svg, const Rect& bounds) override
```

Draws `svg` into `bounds` (see [DrawSvg](render-commands.md#struct-drawsvg)). A backend that cannot draw SVG draws nothing.

## push_opacity_layer

```cpp
void push_opacity_layer(float opacity) override
```

Draws everything until the matching [pop_opacity_layer()](#pop_opacity_layer) as one layer at `opacity` (0..1); see [PushOpacityLayer](render-commands.md#struct-pushopacitylayer).

## pop_opacity_layer

```cpp
void pop_opacity_layer() override
```

Ends the innermost [push_opacity_layer()](#push_opacity_layer).

## push_matrix

```cpp
void push_matrix(const Matrix& transform) override
```

Transforms everything drawn until the matching [pop_transform()](#pop_transform); nested pushes compose, the inner one applying first (see [PushTransform](render-commands.md#struct-pushtransform)). What every [push_transform()](renderer.md#push_transform) overload lands in: a backend implements this one, and callers use [push_transform()](renderer.md#push_transform).

## pop_transform

```cpp
void pop_transform() override
```

Ends the innermost [push_transform()](renderer.md#push_transform).

## set_rasterization

```cpp
void set_rasterization(const SetRasterization& policy) override
```

Sets the theme's rasterization policy (see [SetRasterization](render-commands.md#struct-setrasterization)). [Window::render()](../tree/window.md#render) calls it once per frame, first, from the active [Theme](../themes/theme.md). A backend that ignores it draws everything antialiased, which matches the Modern look.

## replay

```cpp
void replay(Renderer& target) const
```

Draws everything recorded into `target`, in order.

## size

```cpp
std::size_t size() const
```

How many calls were recorded.

## empty

```cpp
bool empty() const
```

True when nothing has been recorded (or since [clear()](#clear)).

## clear

```cpp
void clear()
```

Drops every recorded call, for example to take a new snapshot of the same element.
